headline: Foreign Investors Withdraw US$1.5 Billion from Brazil
summary: Foreign funds have pulled US$1.5 billion from the Brazilian stock market following the election of President Lula. The Ibovespa index declined 18.3% between October 22 and November 4, 2026.
why: Large capital outflows from emerging markets often reflect shifts in investor confidence regarding domestic fiscal policy and political stability.
why_moved: The withdrawal of foreign capital reduces liquidity and demand for Brazilian equities, leading to a sharp decline in the benchmark index.
